# Navimower Map Card 0.3.6-beta2

## Multi mower field-test fixes

- Moves **Multi mower** ownership fully into the card configuration. The visual editor now places a `Multi mower` boolean directly after the main mower entity and it remains disabled by default. The temporary Single/Multi header toggle is removed.
- Keeps automatic Site API mower membership. A second mower entity does not need to be configured manually; the selected main mower remains the site anchor and validated nearby members come from Navimower.
- Hides the global Schedule header button consistently while Multi mower mode is active. Schedule stays available separately in each mower control section.
- Fixes member-scoped Schedule discovery by priming the selected member's Site API frontend metadata before opening the scheduler. Each mower now keeps its own scheduler entities and device id.
- Restores the **live mowing trail line** for every mower in the combined view while retaining the integration-owned current-cycle mowed-area SVG render.
- Moves mower artwork to screen space above dock markers. This prevents a docked mower from being covered by the dock icon and avoids mirroring the artwork through the site transform.
- Corrects Multi mower heading composition by adding the member site's rotation to the same `90 - heading` convention used by Single mower mode.
- Removes the floating mower-name labels from the map. Mower identity remains visible in the per-mower control and session sections without adding zoom-sensitive SVG labels.
- Keeps the merged Notifications dialog authoritative after Home Assistant state updates, preventing the single-anchor notification dialog from replacing it after a moment.

This beta is aimed at the first real two-mower field test. Map alignment from 0.3.6-beta1 is unchanged; the focus is live trail, heading, z-order, scheduler scoping and UI ownership.
